evals.name: full-review-no-briefing
evals.expected_output: Three-phase review on a project with no review/briefing.yaml and no prior committed report. Degrades gracefully (warns, suggests /review-briefing), runs mode: full, writes one review/reports/<run_id>.json plus its .md rendering, and displays the structured summary.

assertions.name: briefing_degradation_warning
assertions.description: Warns about the missing briefing and suggests /review-briefing

assertions.name: mode_full_no_since
assertions.description: method has since none, and method.extra has mode full and full_reason 'no prior report'; the .md opens its ## Method section with a fenced yaml block

assertions.name: three_phases_present
assertions.description: Contains distinct sections for Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 3

assertions.name: tests_actually_executed
assertions.description: Reports real test pass/fail counts from the configured or default test command

assertions.name: lint_or_typecheck_executed
assertions.description: Reports lint or typecheck results with specifics

assertions.name: findings_use_contract_schema
assertions.description: Every finding has key (fk- plus 12 hex), area, anchor, tags with a heuristic lens first, severity in high|medium|low, verdict and disposition

assertions.name: single_run_record
assertions.description: Writes review/reports/<run_id>.json and .md, with run_id of the form review-<project_id>-YYYYMMDD; no phase1-/phase2- files

assertions.name: structured_summary_format
assertions.description: Final output uses the per-phase summary format

evals.name: scoped-fused-memory
evals.expected_output: Review scoped to the fused-memory subproject. Test, lint and typecheck commands are the member's segment or use uv run --directory fused-memory (never --project). Findings carry area fused-memory.

assertions.name: scope_respected
assertions.description: Findings anchor inside fused-memory/ and carry area fused-memory

assertions.name: directory_flag
assertions.description: Any constructed uv command uses --directory fused-memory, never --project

assertions.name: tests_scoped
assertions.description: Tests run against fused-memory specifically

evals.name: phase1-only
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 only — tests, lint, typecheck, smoke. The run record has extra.phases_run [1], a phase1 block, and no findings. Failures are recorded as operational items, not findings.

assertions.name: only_phase1
assertions.description: No Phase 2 or Phase 3 content in output

assertions.name: tests_executed
assertions.description: Reports actual test pass/fail numbers

assertions.name: phase1_block_only
assertions.description: method.extra.phases_run is [1] and findings is empty

assertions.name: failures_not_findings
assertions.description: Any test failure appears under phase1.failures, never as a finding with a key

evals.name: briefing-path
evals.expected_output: Run on a project whose review/briefing.yaml omits a workspace member and has a known_gaps entry with no accepted_by pointer. The validate checks run in report-only mode and both defects land in briefing_defects without blocking the run. Phase 2 judging seats Read docs/code-quality.md and tag findings; a stub matching a known gap is recorded with that gap's accepted_by disposition; design-invariant findings carry an inv-<n> tag.

assertions.name: validate_defects_reported
assertions.description: method.extra.briefing_defects names the missing workspace member and the known gap without accepted_by

assertions.name: no_commit_count_staleness
assertions.description: No staleness warning based on a count of commits since the briefing was updated

assertions.name: quality_doc_read
assertions.description: Judging prompts or transcript show docs/code-quality.md was Read before findings were made

assertions.name: heuristic_tags
assertions.description: At least one finding is tagged with a heuristic that had no step before (h2, h4, h5, h8, comments or tests)

assertions.name: invariant_tag_form
assertions.description: Design-invariant findings use tags of the form inv-<n>

assertions.name: inputs_consumed_recorded
assertions.description: method.inputs_consumed lists the hotspot report (or legacy:<file>) and the codebook; the codebook was read through the digest, not raw

evals.name: since-incremental
evals.expected_output: Incremental run against a project with a prior committed report. Phase 1 runs in full. Phase 2 reviews only the files changed since the given commit plus their direct importers, and re-verifies every open/filed/accepted finding of the prior report at the new as_of_sha; a finding whose anchor no longer exists is recorded fixed:<as_of_sha>. Phase 3 runs the contract §8 key lookup before filing and files the trigger chain.

assertions.name: header_since
assertions.description: method.since equals the resolved commit, method.extra.mode is since, and method.as_of_sha is a full main SHA

assertions.name: phase1_full
assertions.description: Phase 1 ran the whole configured test suite, not only changed modules

assertions.name: scope_listed
assertions.description: Evidence lists changed_files and phase2_files, and Phase 2 findings anchor only inside that set or the carry set

assertions.name: carry_set_reverified
assertions.description: Every open/filed/accepted finding from the prior report appears with last_seen appended or disposition fixed:<as_of_sha>

assertions.name: key_lookup_before_filing
assertions.description: Each routed finding records dedup_step, and no task was filed for a key already on a live task

assertions.name: filed_metadata
assertions.description: Filed tasks carry x_finding_key, x_finding_run and source 'review'; their metadata holds nothing beyond those, files, x_supersedes_task and the R4 pair

assertions.name: trigger_chain
assertions.description: method.extra.trigger_chain names the form (final, interim or none) and the task ids; the chain follows skills/_shared/filing-the-trigger-chain.md: gates carry metadata.trigger_chain with skill 'review' and this run_id, the form was probed in the dark-factory checkout, and any open older /review chain was superseded first, its launching escalation (--launched-from) resolved as 'ran as <run_id>'
